title: NewResource
description: A purple & pink themed resourcepack that adds a stylish, Japanese-inspired aesthetic to Minecraft.
body:
Bring a touch of elegance and color to your Minecraft world with this purple & pink resourcepack!
Perfect for players who love vibrant tones and a refined style, this pack recolors tools, weapons, and items with a unique aesthetic while staying faithful to the vanilla design.
## ✨ Features
- Beautiful purple & pink recolors for tools, weapons, and select items.
- Inspired by Japanese artistic style, with soft and elegant tones.
- Lightweight and vanilla-friendly, ensuring smooth gameplay.
- Adds personality and style without overcomplicating the game.
## 🎮 Why download?
If you want to give Minecraft a stylish and artistic atmosphere, this pack is perfect for you.
It’s simple, beautiful, and gives your tools a vibrant identity that makes them stand out!
